DEMO GROUP HEALTH SHIELD - POLICY WORDING (Version 2)
GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS

1. Entire Contract
The Master Policy Schedule, the Policy Wording, the Certificate of Insurance issued to each Employee and any Endorsements issued shall be read together as one contract. The proposal and enrolment data submitted by the Master Policyholder form the basis of this contract.

2. Order of Precedence
In case of any conflict between the documents forming this contract, an Endorsement shall prevail over the Certificate and the Master Policy Schedule to the extent of the change it records, and the Certificate and the Master Policy Schedule shall prevail over the Policy Wording. The English version of the documents shall prevail over any translation.

3. Role of the Group Administrator
The Master Policyholder acts as Group Administrator for enrolment of Employees and their dependants, for requesting Endorsements and for forwarding communication to Insured Members.

4. Servicing
Claims and cashless requests are administered by the Third Party Administrator named in the Certificate. The Intermediary named in the Certificate services the Master Policy.
